content: उपविषः, -षम् .²1 An artificial poison. .²2 A narcotic, any poisonous drug; अर्कक्षीरं स्नुहीक्षीरं तथैव कलिहारिका . धत्तूरः करवीरश्च पञ्च चोपविषाः स्मृताः .. .{@-षा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (अतिविषा) It is a plant used in medicine. The bark is employed in dying. It is white, red and black (Atis or Betula). It is also referred to as उपविषाणिका.
